sourceAnchors.message: Avoid catching RuntimeException in try-catch block
sourceAnchors.reason: SS333 SSC063/308 requires this owned-body IO/Runtime/Error boundary solely to release exactly once before preserving the specified unknown primary identity; no exception is swallowed or reported successful.

sourceAnchors.message: An instanceof check is being performed on the caught exception. Create a separate catch clause for IOException.
sourceAnchors.reason: SS333 explicitly distinguishes primary IOException plus unknown secondary from unknown-primary priority after the same single release. instanceof implements the independent golden matrix without duplicating or retrying the owned cleanup.

sourceAnchors.message: An instanceof check is being performed on the caught exception. Create a separate catch clause for StorageIoException.
sourceAnchors.reason: SS333 requires preserving an existing StorageIoException reason only with no suppressed failure, otherwise fixed UNAVAILABLE after release. Type inspection is the specified closed error catalog, not an omitted subtype-specific business handler.
